name: Ukraine
description: Follow Ukraine, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Witkoff, Kushner visit Moscow in latest push to end war in Ukraine
changes.summary: Presidents Vladimir Putin and Volodymyr Zelenskyy agreed to pause strikes on each other's capitals while U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner hold talks to revive peace efforts.

changes.title: U.S. envoys in Moscow in new push for peace between Russia and Ukraine
changes.summary: U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner have arrived in Moscow to revive efforts to end Russia's invasion of Ukraine. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has called for a halt to air attacks during their visit, but Moscow has not publicly responded. (Image credit: Francisco Seco).

changes.title: How the U.S. focus on Iran is fueling a more aggressive Putin
changes.summary: Trump's top envoys head to Moscow and Kyiv as Putin steps up round the clock bombing of Ukraine. With the U.S. distracted by Iran, is Putin becoming increasingly emboldened?

changes.title: Here Is Where Ukraine Peace Talks Stand, as a New Round Approaches
changes.summary: A deadly campaign of Russian and Ukrainian airstrikes has escalated since the last U.S.-brokered negotiations stalled in February.

changes.title: Putin meets with U.S. envoys at the Kremlin for renewed talks on ending the war in Ukraine
changes.summary: The envoys' trip comes as both sides escalate aerial attacks, some 4 1/2 years after the Kremlin's invasion of its neighbor.

changes.title: U.S. Diesel Prices Set New High
changes.summary: Because of the war in Iran, the cost has climbed past the record it reached in 2022 after Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

changes.title: News Wrap: 2 men rescued from Nepal tunnel 9 days after catastrophic flood
changes.summary: In our news wrap Friday, two men were pulled from a tunnel more than a week after the catastrophic deluge that barreled through Himalayan river valleys, Ukraine's president says a Russian drone struck the headquarters of the country's security service and New York police fatally shot a man wielding a knife on the city'.

changes.title: After Fighting Russia Fiercely, He Wants to Forge Ukraine’s Path to Peace
changes.summary: Kyrylo Budanov, a decorated soldier and former military spy chief, advocates a negotiated settlement. Talks are expected to resume this month.

changes.title: Kushner and Witkoff to Go to Russia and Ukraine to Revive Peace Talks
changes.summary: Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff’s trip to meet with the countries’ presidents comes at a precarious moment in the Ukraine conflict.

changes.title: Russian Drone Strikes Office of Ukraine’s Intelligence Chief
changes.summary: The attack came as the American envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner were said to be planning imminent visits to Kyiv and to Moscow.
